title: Understanding Thresholds
text: To determine the threshold, consider the probabilities where the prediction changes from $$0$$ to $$1$$ or vice versa. Look at the probabilities given for each prediction and think about where the threshold might lie.

title: Analyzing Predictions
text: Notice the predictions and their corresponding probabilities. A prediction of $$1$$ with a probability less than the threshold would be incorrect, and a prediction of $$0$$ with a probability greater than the threshold would also be incorrect.

title: Choosing the Minimum Threshold
text: Which probability value is the highest among those where the prediction is 0?

title: Choosing the Maximum Threshold
text: Which probability value is the lowest among those where the prediction is 1?
